# `AutoGoto`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Auto-goto (slew, solve, re-centre) progress from the function detail and the legacy retry notifier.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, NotifyAutoGotoState @0x170500, PrintAutoGotoInfo @0x16e8b0, AutoGotoFunc @0x172d90 (64-bit build) |

Sent by the auto-goto worker's named transitions (F) and by the legacy auto-goto state notifier retry path (start, working, delay, complete, fail with page, tag, func). Function-state family (F): the event formatter formats the named function detail. state is always present; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms while the timer runs or at a terminal state; error and code at fail (even when the stored code is zero; lookup failure gives 'fail to operate'); cancel omits code and error; route is optional function ancestry. The sender does no deduplication and needs no preceding working event. Detail flags can suppress the working or non-working sends while the cached function tree still changes, so a receiver can miss transitions. Its formatter adds count and hint. Child ScopeGoto, Exposure, PlateSolve and AutoFocus events can arrive before the AutoGoto completion. Mount errors during goto are sent separately as AutoGotoStep. iscope_stop_view with stage AutoGoto stops it. The legacy direct event always carries page and func, and tag when non-empty; start adds target_ra_dec (only when the RA is not the -999 sentinel) and target_name (only when non-empty); working adds count; any legacy state adds error and code when the worker passes a non-zero code. The F path adds hint, target_name and target_ra_dec to the F set. No further members are known; this union is complete (INFERRED: no third producer was found). Channel I (TCP 4700). Delivery: ordinary broadcast to every retained socket of the emitting server (master, guest and never-verified sockets alike); no cadence, delivery or ordering guarantee relative to RPC replies or other events. APK 3.3.2 consumes it.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"AutoGoto"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Union. F: idle, working, complete, fail, cancel. Legacy auto-goto state notifier: start, working, delay, complete, fail. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`, `start`, `delay`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if stage string non-empty | - | Only when the detail holds a non-empty stage string; value set unresolved. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds (signed 32-bit low bits): current monotonic time minus start while working or started-but-unfinished, otherwise end minus start. Independent of Timestamp. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if F: state is fail. Legacy: any state, when the passed code is non-zero | - | Message for code. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if F: state is fail. Legacy: any state, when the passed code is non-zero | - | F: stored error code, present at fail even when zero. Legacy: the passed code, only when non-zero. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | no | - | Function-ancestry names at send time (for example View, Stack); may be absent. Not an address. [READ] |
| `count` | integer | no | - | Attempt/step count (callback-retained value); on the legacy producer only with working. [READ] |
| `hint` | boolean | no | - | From the F formatter. [READ] |
| `page` | string | if legacy producer | - | Legacy producer: source page. [READ] |
| `tag` | string | if legacy producer, tag non-empty | - | Legacy producer: tag. [READ] |
| `func` | string | if legacy producer | - | Legacy producer: auto-goto function step name. [READ] |
| `target_name` | string | if legacy start with a non-empty name; F print hook (condition unresolved) | - | Target name (legacy start; F print hook). [READ] |
| `target_ra_dec` | array<number> | if legacy start when the RA is not the -999 sentinel; F print hook (condition unresolved) | - | Target coordinate pair (legacy start; F print hook). Range: at least 2 item(s). [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, working - F progress (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"AutoGoto","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":4200,"count":1,"hint":false,"route":["View"]}
```

Event, legacy-start - Legacy start (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"AutoGoto","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"start","page":"preview","tag":"example","func":"example","target_name":"Example target","target_ra_dec":[5.5,22.0]}
```
